blocks.text: Then the Brahmins came and cried before the Satguru: you are the manifest protector of the spiritual order — now this burden has fallen upon us, so save us. (20–21)
If the Hindus are to remain rooted in Hind, it is only through your defense; otherwise the imperial decree will erase them one after another. (22)
Therefore we have come to your refuge. If you are truly the heroic Satguru, then carry the drowning Hindus across. (23)
